commentary.text: 90+14' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+13' Craig Pawson shows the yellow card to Djed Spence (Tottenham) for a heavy challenge.
90+9' Tottenham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+8' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+8' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Craig Pawson lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+6' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robert Sanchez, who smothers the ball.
90+1' Enzo Maresca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea) replacing Cole Palmer.
90+1' The game has come to an end for Enzo Fernandez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Chelsea).
90+1' Tottenham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' The fourth official shows 12 min. of added time.

90' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Robert Sanchez pulls off a brilliant save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Tottenham.
88' Here comes a substitution. Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is brought on as a substitute for Micky van de Ven.
88' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Mathys Tel (Tottenham) replaces James Maddison.
86' A yellow card is awarded to Cole Palmer (Chelsea).
86' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) is flagged for offside.
84' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) serves up a nice cross, but Guglielmo Vicario punches the ball away.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Reece James (Chelsea) comes onto the pitch for Nicolas Jackson.
82' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Tottenham comes to nothing.
81' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by James Maddison (Tottenham). The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
80' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Pedro Neto (Chelsea), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
77' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
73' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Marc Cucurella (Chelsea).
72' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) gets a yellow card.
72' The goal by Tottenham is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
71' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Tottenham players aren’t happy.
69' Goal! Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) finds some space for a shot from the edge of the box and his attempt goes low inside the right post. Fantastic finish.
68' Substitution. Noni Madueke (Chelsea) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jadon Sancho walks off.
67' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
67' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
65' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Ange Postecoglou decides to make a substitution. Lucas Bergvall will be replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).
64' Wilson Odobert will be replaced by Brennan Johnson (Tottenham).
64' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
60' Celebrations are cut short for Chelsea as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
57' The Chelsea players halt their celebrations as referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
56' Goal! Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 2:0.
56' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
56' James Maddison (Tottenham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Craig Pawson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
54' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) latched onto a loose pass on the edge of the box and let fly, but Guglielmo Vicario saw it all the way and made a fine save to deny him.
53' The game is interrupted as Djed Spence (Tottenham) is flagged offside.

50' 1 - 0 Goal! Cole Palmer plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 1:0.
48' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
47' Craig Pawson has a clear sight and sees a foul from Destiny Udogie (Tottenham).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Craig Pawson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) gets booked for the first time in this match.
45+1' Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) is awarded a yellow card.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Chelsea.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

45' CHANCE! Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a sublime shot towards Guglielmo Vicario, but the goalkeeper stands tall and produces an excellent save. Now Chelsea have a corner.
43' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
41' The linesman raises his flag. James Maddison (Tottenham) is adjudged offside.
38' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) sends the corner into the box, but Robert Sanchez intercepts it and averts the threat.

37' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman makes the right call and Tottenham will have a corner.
32' Chelsea have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
31' A shot from the edge of the box by Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is close, but lifts narrowly over the bar at the last second.
29' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
28' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. It will be a corner kick for Chelsea.
27' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
24' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
19' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Cole Palmer (Chelsea).
15' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is ready and denies him.
15' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Guglielmo Vicario intercepts the ball.
14' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) swings in a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario reads it well and gathers the ball.
9' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
8' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
6' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
5' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
4' The corner is swung in but Tottenham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

3' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Tottenham.
2' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) has a big opportunity inside the penalty area, pulls the trigger, but one of the defending players is in the way of his shot and the ball bounces onto the post off him.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Craig Pawson.
